title: Detection-Grounded Symmetric AoII: traces, power logs and analysis code
description: Event traces and per-frame content scores for 121 surveillance videos (3713 events, 166589 frames), raw 10 Hz board-power logs from an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, and the analysis code that reproduces every number and figure of the accompanying paper on worst-case symmetric age-of-incorrect-information certificates for sampling policies in edge perception. Code is MIT licensed; data are CC BY 4.0. The source videos are not redistributed.
